glossary.definition: (1) "Capacity affording extensive contact with minor children" means any capacity in which a person would be working directly and in an unaccompanied setting with minor children on more than an incidental and occasional basis or would have supervision or disciplinary power over minor children.
glossary.normalized: capacity affording extensive contact with minor children
glossary.source_title: Section 2950.035 - Unlawful work with or supervision of minors.
glossary.term: Capacity affording extensive contact with minor children

glossary.definition: (2) "Prosecuting authority" means the prosecuting attorney, village solicitor, city or township director of law, similar chief legal officer of a municipal corporation or township, or official designated as a prosecutor in a municipal corporation that has jurisdiction over the place at which a person serves in a position in violation of division (A)(1) or (2) of this section.
glossary.source_title: Section 2950.035 - Unlawful work with or supervision of minors.

glossary.definition:
(3) "Working directly and in an unaccompanied setting" includes, but is not limited to, providing goods or services to minors.
